review.title: These Toblerone Biscoff truffles are dangerously good
review.quote: They’re rich, but not overly sweet, and have a good texture with some crunch.

basis: Milk-chocolate truffles round a Biscoff spread with honey and almond nougat: caramel-spiced and very sweet, little bitterness. October 27 research: firsthand CostcoCanada account by u/minutemaiding, with photographed Toblerone Diamond Truffles with Biscoff packaging. Exact publication day could not be reconciled from relative page dates and inconsistent search dating; left null. This is a consumer tasting, not a professional blind review.

review.title: I Tried Absolut's New Tabasco-Flavored Vodka & I Can Still Feel The Heat
review.quote: It has a peppery, vinegary Tabasco-style kick that builds and lingers, especially in a shot.

basis: Four reviewers (Difford's, The Takeout, The Daily Pour, Tastings): heat dominant with a long peppery finish and a vinegar tang, only a faint sweetness. October 27 research adds Sean Abrams’s explicitly dated January 28 firsthand tasting in Sweden and at home. Existing Tastings extract remains undated: Date Tasted is not an established publication date.
